read.thesis: Verizon's Q3 beat rests on subsidy cuts and cost-out, not supply discipline: postpaid phone net adds of 406,000 and a record 40.2% EBITDA margin, with FY net-add guidance raised to 1.1–1.2 million.

capex.quote: We are on track to meet our full-year guide of $16 billion-$16.5 billion, inclusive of success-based capital related to AI Connect.

triggers.label: Postpaid phone net adds guide raised
triggers.quote: we are raising our annual guidance for postpaid phone net adds, adjusted EPS, and free cash flow

triggers.label: Mobility & broadband service rev growth 2.9% → ~4% Q4
triggers.quote: we expect that Q4 mobility and broadband service revenue growth will accelerate to approximately 4%

triggers.label: Cost of acquisition down 41% YoY
triggers.quote: our cost of acquisition in the third quarter declined 41% year-over-year

triggers.label: Equipment revenue down 9%, upgrades down 20%+
triggers.quote: mobile device upgrade volumes declined more than 20% in the period

guidance.quote: We now expect our postpaid phone net adds for 2026 to be 1.1 million-1.2 million
we now expect our 2026 full-year adjusted EPS growth to be 7%-7.5%, up from our previous range of 6%-7%
we are raising our full-year guidance for free cash flow growth to approach 12%, up from our previous guidance of 9%-10%
We are on track to meet our full-year guide of $16 billion-$16.5 billion
we now expect mobility and broadband service revenue growth to be in the upper half of our 2.5%-3% range
we continue to expect to end the year with over 32 million fiber passings
We continue to expect to repurchase up to $4.5 billion for the full year.
on track to deliver over $1 billion in run rate operating cost synergies by 2028

red_flags.label: Equipment revenue down 9%; upgrade volumes down 20%+
red_flags.quote: mobile device upgrade volumes declined more than 20% in the period

red_flags.label: Net debt/EBITDA still 2.3x; target reached only in 2027
red_flags.quote: We remain on track to reach our target leverage range during the 2027 timeframe.

evasions.quote: there's potentially room for us to adjust that price-to-value equation by increasing pricing as well

evasions.topic: AI Connect deal economics and margins
evasions.quote: the deals are very customer specific, so no two deals are alike
